name: Scene 5

voice.notes: Exact English words; slow clear consonants; no extra dialogue; separate eating/drinking from speech

ambience: Bamboo leaf bed and relaxed visitor-side pause.
sfx_intent: Separate quiet panda bamboo texture. Mother cap unscrew A under words has no accent; mother-supported sip only after2.99. Cap closure B0–1 stays quiet under words; accented click only if measured contact is outside voiced interval. Father banana contact after3.29, window3.55–3.95; optional one tiny soft accent, no competing bamboo swish. Preserve quiet repeat window.
music: Gentle cheerful original pentatonic plucked/marimba-style instrumental, no lyrics, quiet underneath canonical Alice, duck smoothly during all words, stable modest level through transitions.

cue_policy.footsteps: Align transient to actual observed contact frame; eventframes pending rendered motion
cue_policy.animal: Prefer gaps between words; avoid masking first/final consonants
cue_policy.props: Cue visible contact and audible transient; do not align blindly to file start
cue_policy.measurement: planned seconds distinct from measured source PTS/local/global frames

asset_policy: Record license/source/hash for acquired recordings. Existing synthesized cues are synthesized, not authentic animal recordings. No downloads/substitutions without provenance.
performance_and_foley: Mother LEFT hand supports bottle, RIGHT hand holds cap; father RIGHT hand holds box, LEFT offers banana. Both child hands free. A: speech1.00–2.99; quiet cap opening during speech; sip3.25–4.35. B: quiet cap closure0–1, speech0.35–3.29; tiny banana bite3.55–3.95, calm chewing afterward into Scene6. No crunchy banana or exaggerated gulp. Actual swallowing not verified.

postproduction.voice_priority: Original saved Alice; no duplicated generated speech; clear consonants and natural pace
postproduction.music: Cheerful original quiet instrumental, no lyrics; further ducking measured because source music already ducked
postproduction.animal_style: Soft non-startling cues, label synthesized sources honestly
postproduction.lighting_picture: Stable warm daylight, restrained saturation, no sudden exposure/white-balance changes; match consecutive boundaries
postproduction.review: Visual contacts, actual dialogue clock, subtitles, normal-speed listening and loudness/true-peak checks before completion Verify foreground gap budget, actual mouth readiness and explicit hand ownership. Keep mouth sounds subtle; no artificial accelerated chewing.

foreground_gap_budget: At most one quiet foreground accent per speech-free gap; reserve remaining gap for child imitation. Footstep bed barely audible. Never stack chuff/paw/props accents. Inspect already-ducked music before additional ducking.

required_audio_rebuild.method: Move exact original savedAlice PCM; no stretch, trim, reclone or new speaker. Rebuild/version canonical60s, Scene5A/B guide WAV, captions, ducking envelope and cue receipts before submission.
required_audio_rebuild.completion: OriginalPCM canonical60s and Scene5Bguide rebuilt, strictdecoded, source/outputhashes and all12copyranges verified independently. Source S05Aguide unchanged. Captions/ducking/finalcue receipts still required at finishing.
